backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.intro: Progress is stored locally unless you enable automatic backups. Export a backup file to keep your settings and unlocked-achievement records safe, then import it after reinstalling Windows or the app.
includes: Settings (options.ini, including encrypted Steam API key)
Local unlock records used for notifications and progress
Playtime tracked by Achievement Watcher (Windows registry)
excludes: Steam schema cache (downloaded again when needed)
Original achievement files in game/emulator folders or external screenshots/videos
backup.exportHelp: Saves a .awbackup.zip file (e.g. to Downloads or a USB drive).
backup.importHelp: Restore settings and local progress from .awbackup.zip. You may also import options.ini to restore settings only.

automatic.title: Automatic backups to a cloud-synced folder
automatic.intro: Choose a folder synced by OneDrive, Dropbox, Google Drive, or another provider. A first backup is created immediately; later backups are created when app-managed data changes. The 10 newest automatic backups are kept.
automatic.folderHelp: Achievement Watcher writes backup files here; your cloud provider handles uploading and syncing.
automatic.statusNotConfigured: Choose a folder to set up automatic backups.
automatic.privacy: Backup files are not encrypted as a whole. Protect your cloud account. Original game/emulator files and external screenshots or videos are not included.
automatic.successMessage: The backup was saved locally. Your cloud provider may need time to upload it.

backup.errorDestinationInvalid: The backup folder is unavailable or overlaps app data.
backup.errorWatch: Automatic backups could not monitor app data changes.
backup.errorSettings: Automatic backup settings are invalid. Choose the folder again.
backup.importConfirmMessage: Current settings and local progress will be replaced by the backup. Continue?
backup.importConfigConfirmMessage: Only the settings in this file will be restored. Continue?
backup.importSuccessMessage: Data restored. The app will reload to apply changes.
backup.errorInvalid: The file is not a valid Achievement Watcher backup.
backup.errorVersion: This backup was created with a newer format. Update the app and try again.
backup.errorNotFound: The backup file could not be found.
backup.errorWrite: Could not write the backup. Check free space and write permissions.
